title: OrganismalSystemsBiology/Neuron-atlas-analysis: Whole-Brain Single-Neuron Atlas Analysis Pipeline (v1.0.1)
description: Source code, CUDA/C++ 3D cell-candidate segmentation kernels, registration pipelines, spatial statistical models, and peer-review validation notebooks supporting 'Whole-Brain Single-Neuron Atlas Reveals a Microglial Security-Hole Pattern' (Mitani T.T. et al., Nature). Companion processed datasets are publicly available in the EMBL-EBI BioImage Archive (S-BIAD4432).
